main: same float64 transplanted eval function for responses and fixed input AD
required_finite: used fusion parameters and affine coefficients
negative_metric_handling: invalid implementation/numerical result, STOP; do not clamp

FD.eligibility: computed finite,whole-vector representable,same computed nonzero ternary regions; empirical only
FD.rule: eligible residual tolerance; no rounding-envelope eligibility

chain_AD.rule: all1024 coordinates of each of40 groups pass fixed tolerance

algebra.scale: sum of absolute terms on both sides
algebra.lower_bound: signed_lower_bound_residual = U_src - (E_D + E_P + E_DP); require residual <= atol + rtol*scale; scale=sum of absolute terms on both sides; no clipping; link analogue = abs(I_src)-(abs(eps_D)+abs(eps_P)+abs(eps_DP))

R_identity.scale: sum absolute terms on both sides
R_identity.rule: only when all required raw ratios defined; otherwise SKIPPED_RATIO_UNDEFINED with reason

priority: mandatory E/B/E_perm finite and nonnegative or STOP
B>tau_B: attempt binary64 E/B or E_perm/B independently
ratio-only overflow/nonfinite => UNDEFINED_RATIO_NONFINITE,null; do not STOP otherwise valid absolute primary endpoint
R_eligibility.zero_denominator: covered by low-B; no division attempted
R_eligibility.R_perm: same B, independent numerator and ratio state; do not inherit R status
R_eligibility.aggregate: all required raw ratios defined before same fixed-weight average; any missing => aggregate null, AGGREGATE_INCOMPLETE_RAW_R; retain expected/defined counts and reasons, no subset or renormalization
R_eligibility.zero_control: derived R_zero=1 when B>tau_B,not inherited frommain optional ratio status

paired_direction.finite_difference: delta<0 OBSERVED_LOWER; delta>0 OBSERVED_HIGHER; exact computed +/-0 EXACT_COMPUTED_ZERO
paired_direction.missing_ratio: DeltaR null,NOT_EVALUABLE with exact missing raw-slot reasons; DeltaE independently retained

finite_JSON: no NaN/Infinity; optional undefined ratio uses null with status; required nonfinite is terminal stopped-prefix evidence
